name: runner-handoff-review-repair
goal: The runner's handoff owns a process only by id and start time, guards every signal with a fresh look at identity and program, keeps a service's protection for what it started, and always ends its cleanup within a bound.

evidence: Review of the frozen handoff found: ownership by historical pid; kill by raw pid after a batch; protection lost when the service is absent or filtered out; cleanup without bound or error result.
